### A Supreme Act of Faith
Author: Greg Laurie
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/harvestdaily/a-supreme-act-of-faith-greg-laurie-daily-devotion-may-12-2015.html
Passage: Genesis 6:22
Points:
- Noah demonstrated extraordinary trust in God by constructing an ark far from water and before rain had ever fallen.
- Genuine faith originates from hearing God's word and actively putting it into practice.
- Noah’s obedience was driven by godly reverence and a healthy dread of displeasing the Lord.
- Walking in close communion with God naturally leads to working faithfully for Him.
- Good works do not produce salvation, but authentic faith will always express itself in tangible obedience.

### An Ark of Gopher Wood
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/ark-gopher-wood
Passage: Genesis 6:14
Points:
- God provided Noah with meticulous structural instructions for the ark to secure shelter from coming judgment.
- Like the detailed design of the tabernacle, the ark foreshadows Christ as God's appointed refuge from wrath.
- Noah was preserved through faith by trusting himself completely to God’s gracious deliverance.
- The connection between the flood and baptism highlights salvation received through faith rather than outward water.
- Believers today rest in the same covenant promises as Noah, looking back to the Savior who has already arrived.
